Jane Austen, Sense and Sensibility.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/jane-austen/sense-and-sensibility

People whose words are in the text, and their death dates:
- Jane Austen, author. Death dates in the facts file: 1817-07-18, 1877-07-24, 1817-01-01.

First publication of the text used: 1811 (SE colophon: 'Sense and Sensibility was published in 1811 by Jane Austen.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's own rights statement (quoted below) says the text is in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication, and it does not matter here. Every death date listed for every person whose words are in the text is in 1925 or earlier (latest listed: 1877, Jane Austen). The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
